title: Gym CRM AC-07
description: Acceptance criterion AC-07 of the Gym CRM (milestone M2).

acceptanceCriteria.text: Reminder steps at 60 minutes, 24 hours, 3 hours and 60 minutes before the visit, and 15 days are created at the right time; overdue steps appear in "Today's tasks" and count as late in the audit; the "Báo Studio" step creates a task for the coach manager.
